reviews_list.name: Aaliya Khan
reviews_list.quote: I have never had a colour match my skin undertone the way it did at Sivarra. The chair, the light, the silence — every detail is considered.

reviews_list.name: Rajat Mehrotra
reviews_list.quote: Walked in for a trim. Walked out feeling like a different man. The beard sculpt alone is worth the trip across town.

reviews_list.name: Ira Saxena
reviews_list.quote: My bridal look was crafted over three sittings — patient, generous, unhurried. The team treated my mother and me with the same care.
